# Mojialand

> Seven picture games for kids 3 and up. Plays in the web browser on phones, tablets and computers, with nothing to download. No ads. No accounts. No chat. Nothing collected from your child.

Mojialand is made by DisplayedUX, a small studio in Michigan, United States. It went live on September 28, 2026.

## Facts for parents

- Ages: 3 and up. No reading needed. Every button is a picture.
- No ads, ever.
- No coins, no loot boxes and no shop inside the games.
- Kids never see a price, a buy button or a link to another site.
- No accounts, no sign-up, no login and no chat.
- Nothing collected from your child.
- Purchases sit behind a grown-up check (a number question).
- Plays in Safari, Chrome and other web browsers on iPhone, iPad, Android phones and tablets, Mac, Windows and Chromebook. No app store download. Adds to the Home Screen to play full screen.

## Games

- Draw: stamp and draw with crayons, markers, paint and a coloring book.
- Pattern: finish the pattern.
- Match: match pairs.
- Bounce: drop friends into a box and watch them bounce.
- Parade: build a parade.
- Share Party: share food fairly between friends.
- Feelings Faces: name how a friend feels.

## Price

- Every game is free for 7 days on each device. After that, 3 free minutes a day.
- 30-day pass: $4.99, one-time charge, never renews.
- Forever pass: $14.99, one-time charge.
- Never a subscription. One pass covers up to 5 devices.
